title: OSIRIS governed multi-agent execution: development snapshot (feature/governed-trio @ 541187d7)
description:
Development snapshot, not a release. Source tree of the OSIRIS repository at branch feature/governed-trio, commit 541187d7d11f497f1a448b80c928222691339adc (7 commits on top of upstream origin/main @ 9896f04a). The branch is unreviewed and unmerged.

Added on this branch: a prototype governed Research/Developer/Critic execution slice (agent contracts with checked state transitions and digests); a deterministic evidence firewall that quarantines or rejects unsupported test and measurement claims; an evolutionary-candidate bridge that records every outcome in an append-only lineage ledger and never applies a patch, with promotion requiring PromotionPolicy plus a signed, single-use, payload-bound grant; an OSIRIS-side agent-gene adapter (RFC-0001 Phase 0, no language change); a /trio command module that is not wired into the REPL; and a fix so approved paste-learning notes are retrievable in conversation.

Evidence status: all tests for these additions use synthetic fixtures. Full suite on this commit: 1674 passed, 13 skipped, 1 failed; the one failure (tests/test_exec_policy.py::test_symlink_named_ls_pointing_at_rm_is_treated_as_rm) also fails on upstream main and was not investigated here. Nothing here demonstrates reliability with a live language model, and the record makes no new scientific or quantum-hardware claim. The archive contains the complete repository tree at that commit, including earlier research artifacts already covered by prior records.

Secret scan (detect-secrets 1.5.0) over the full tree: no credentials found; hits were high-entropy hashes, base64 circuit blobs, and test fixtures.
